rationale: Built on the current recurrent-tail baseline instead of another scalar sweep. This run adds a compact, compile-stable structural change: recurrent tail blocks now anneal from the original decoder-output anchor toward a partially refreshed local anchor as recurrence gain rises, while keeping the last reverse-tail block fully anchored. Hypothesis: this preserves the winning reverse-tail anchor behavior early, but reduces over-constraining of earlier recurrent passes late in training and at export time, improving the final int8+zlib roundtrip metric without adding parameter-heavy paths or changing eval/export plumbing.
title: Reverse-Tail Anchor Refresh Curriculum
